prompt:
16:9 photograph in the evening under floodlights at an outdoor public running track in a neighborhood park: a red rubber track with plain white lane lines (no numbers or text painted on the track), five runners doing interval sprints, each in their own lane, spread out so no two bodies overlap. Side view from trackside at a medium distance: each runner mid-stride with the front knee lifted and the rear leg extended behind, both legs clearly separate, arms bent and pumping. Dark trees and a low fence behind, a few distant park lamps, no tall buildings, no city skyline, no river. Faces turned away or in soft profile, not identifiable.
Anatomy and clothing must be correct for every person: exactly two arms and two legs, five fingers on each visible hand, natural joints, natural limb length and body proportions; legs are clearly separate from each other with visible space between them, never fused, merged, duplicated, stretched, bent backward, or blended into the ground, equipment, shadows or another person; each person wears one matching pair of identical running shoes (left and right the same model and color); simple plain running clothes only (solid t-shirt or singlet, shorts or leggings), no harnesses, no tangled straps, cords or earphone wires; no bags.
Style: real-looking candid editorial photograph for a Korean running-crew app, natural light, shallow-to-medium depth of field, subtle film grain, true-to-life color (no heavy filters, no yellow color cast). Everyday anonymous runners in their 20s-30s of mixed pace and body types; faces turned away, in profile at a distance, or too small to identify. No logos on clothing, shoes or objects, no readable text, signage or numbers anywhere, no famous or recognizable landmark (buildings and bridges stay generic and hazy). No illustration, no 3D render, no watermark.
note: 도시 야경·스카이라인 구도(P2)를 바꿈. 저녁 공원 트랙을 옆에서 본 구도, 다섯 명 모두 두 다리가 떨어져 보이는 후보를 원본 크기로 확인해 고름
